name: Post Matric Scholarship To Scheduled Tribe Students Of Nagaland
briefDescription: The Directorate of Higher Education (DHE) has launched the Post Matric Scholarship to ST students of the Nagaland scheme for providing socio-economic welfare to the students belonging to the residentship of Nagaland state. The student must be studying or getting admission to the post-matric class.
benefitsMd: 1. To provide social security provisions to the students of post-metric classes. 1. Students will be able to pursue studies. 1. To provide financial assistance to these students to complete their studies at the college level. 1. Providing socio-economic welfare to the students belonging to the residentship of Nagaland state.
eligibilityMd: - The applicant should be pursuing post-matric studies (above Class X) and belong to the Scheduled Tribe of Nagaland. - The applicant should have parents’/guardian’s annual income not exceeding ₹2.50 lakh from all sources. - The applicant should be studying in an institution with a valid AISHE/UDISE code. - The applicant should not be a repeater (students who failed in the last examination are not eligible). - The applicant should not have availed this scholarship at the same stage of education in a different stream or subject. - The applicant should not have a study break of more than two years. - The applicant should not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship scheme. - The applicant should not be employed in any Government or Semi-Government establishment. - The applicant should be pursuing a Diploma or Certificate course of at least two years duration, if applicable, and must fulfil all the above criteria. - The applicant should be studying under NIOS, if applicable, and must fulfil the above criteria and have passed Class 10 with English, Alternative English/MIL, Science, Mathematics, and Social Science for Class 11 or 12 level courses.
applicationMd: Step 1: Institutions inform students about the scholarship and fix a deadline for submission of[ forms](https://highereducation.nagaland.gov.in) and documents. Step 2: Institutions verify applications, prepare Annexure IV, and ensure the applicant’s bank account is in their own name. Step 3: Institutions display the list of eligible/rejected students for correction before final submission. Step 4: Submit Annexure IV (soft and hard copy) along with required documents to the Department within the deadline. Step 5: The Head of Institution ensures all documents are complete and genuine.
